name: Katsuji Press
description: Katsuji Press — A letterpress print shop theme laid out as horizontal strips in asagi light blue-green (#00A3AF), the main colour on the header bar, the hero, the process band and every page head, with sumi ink black, cool cotton paper and deep asagi links; Potta One display over Noto Sans JP. The art is sumi-ink raster illustration (black brush strokes and grey washes with asagi accents) used as collage: torn-edged pieces of paper taped and overlapped, a sideways-scrolling strip of print-menu cards, and a 1952 platen press and an ink brayer as transparent cut-outs that break out of the hero frame, the section edge and a card. A full top header: a sumi strip with an Order a quote button, then the menu split into two halves either side of the centred press name. Vertical Japanese only on Japanese text; English always runs horizontally. The print menu and the press details are synced patterns edited in one place. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-18 (horizontal-strip archetype, cutout-break-frame-object hero, split nav, collage images, sumi-ink illustration, asagi #00A3AF, Potta One + Noto Sans JP). Contrast: sumi ink #101A1C on asagi #00A3AF 5.8:1 (all text on the asagi header bar, hero, process band, cards and page heads); white on sumi 17.7:1; asagi on sumi 5.8:1 (footer name, header strip button); sumi on cotton paper #F2F7F6 16.4:1; deep asagi #00666E on paper 6.2:1 and on white 6.7:1; white on deep asagi 6.7:1; quiet #3D4A4C on paper 8.5:1; sumi on pale #BFE6E8 13.2:1; white never on asagi (3.1:1).

summary.zh-TW: 水墨插畫風的活版印刷工房網站：淺葱色主視覺上，去背的老式印刷機衝出畫框，下方是橫向捲動的印刷品項拼貼卡與製程色帶。
summary.en: A sumi-ink letterpress shop site: an asagi hero with a cut-out platen press breaking its frame, a sideways print-menu strip and collage.
summary.ja: 墨絵風の活版印刷所サイト。浅葱色のヒーローで切り抜きの印刷機が枠を越え、横スクロールの品目カードとコラージュが続きます。
summary.fr: Une imprimerie typographique à l'encre sumi : héros asagi où une presse détourée déborde du cadre, bande défilante et collage.
summary.de: Eine Buchdruckerei in Sumi-Tusche: Asagi-Hero mit freigestellter Tiegelpresse über dem Rahmen, seitlicher Druckstreifen, Collage.
